headline: F1 'Taxable incomes ... are charged at the rate of': the brackets can be read as slabs, which would make the tax jump by SSP 2,000 at 40,001 a month

scale.source: Financial Act 2024/2025 s. 4(2)(e): 'Taxable income from SSP 90,001 and above ... twenty percent (20%)' a month, x 12
scale.basis: Financial Act 2024/2025 s. 4(2)(e): 'Taxable income from SSP 90,001 and above ... twenty percent (20%)' a month, x 12. A statutory band threshold, not an average wage: 1 'AW' in scanner output = this amount of annual income.

registry_correction: Registry 'Taxation Act 2009 as amended' confirmed and completed: each year's Financial Act replaces Schedule 1 of the Taxation Act 2009; FY 2024/25 monthly brackets 0/5/10/15/20 % (20,000 / 40,000 / 57,000 / 90,000 SSP); states also levy a personal income tax (Constitution art. 179(d)).
